# Abstrekkt — Portable Project Package

**Generated:** 2026-07-11 · **Generated by:** Claude (Cowork), from the attached Abstrekkt project (225 docs) + project instructions
**Package tier:** Complete · **Audience:** Kyle Rosebrook + next AI agent (staff-level, terse)
**Scope:** Abstrekkt org at structural level; **deep** on FlashFusion + pre-revenue blockers. Memoir / plugins / Load-Bearing captured as status + open loops only.

---

## What this is

A consolidated, portable snapshot of the Abstrekkt business as of 2026-07-11, built by cross-checking the current project instructions against the actual project knowledge base. It is designed to be:

- **Downloaded / archived** as-is.
- **Pasted into another model** (see `/09-handoff/MODEL_CONTEXT_*.md`).
- **Continued** without re-running discovery (see `/09-handoff/CONTINUATION_PROMPT.md`).

It is **not** a rebuild of the memoir, the newsletter, or the 244-plugin product. Those are logged with status and open loops, not reconstructed.

## Source-of-truth hierarchy (read in this order)

1. **Project instructions** ("Abstrekkt — Project Instructions", updated 2026-07-07) — the governing document. Where anything here conflicts with an older artifact, the instructions win.
2. `01-source-inventory/SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md` — the resolved authority map for this package.
3. This package's registers (`/07-decisions-and-risks/`).
4. Individual project docs (named inline throughout).

## Provenance tagging (used throughout)

- **[SOURCED — doc]** — verified against a named project doc or the project instructions this session.
- **[GENERATED]** — reasoned estimate or synthesis by the package author; not stated as fact in the KB.
- **!** prefix — a contradiction between two sources.
- **[UNVERIFIED]** — stated as fact somewhere in the KB but unsupported by evidence found this session.

## Known limitations of this package

- No live Drive / Illinois SOS / IRS / broker access was used. LLC-filing and E&O-binding status are reported exactly as the KB states them: **prepared/unstarted, not confirmed done.**
- The KB was sampled, not read exhaustively (225 docs). Sampling targeted the highest-authority docs; unsampled docs may contain additional detail. See `VALIDATION_REPORT.md`.
- Anything client-identifying is kept anonymous per project rules (Art especially; Ryan/Iron Horse is the one named case-study consented in-KB).
